upper_bound.quote: and use at most \(q-1\) cuts in total (standard; details omitted).
upper_bound.witness: For every disjoint A,B with nonempty B and s_A≥s_B, the write-up must explicitly construct at most q−1 distinct legal interior cuts producing paired equal cells and only an A-tail, and prove the cut count. The quoted passage merely asserts this construction and defers its details.
upper_bound.load_bearing: The upper half of the refinement lemma depends on this construction. Xiang’s all-n upper bound then invokes that lemma, so without the omitted argument the claimed upper bound is not established.

parsed.notes: The drafting reduction and Liu’s binary lower bound are proved for all n. Xiang’s bound depends on the unproved overlay construction explicitly labeled “details omitted”; the B-empty case does not cover general minimizing pairs.
